summary: Experiment 1 (Random-Precedent Control, N=93): Evaluated whether retrieval gains reflect domain-specific precedent content or general exemplar/style priming. Under gate-v2 format, zero-shot ROUGE-L F1 is 0.1950, random-precedent ROUGE-L F1 is 0.1985, and real top-1 RAG ROUGE-L F1 is 0.1969. Delta random_minus_zeroshot is +0.0036 (99% Bonferroni CI [-0.0222, 0.0331], status: crosses zero). Delta real_minus_random is -0.0017 (99% Bonferroni CI [-0.0247, 0.0172], status: crosses zero). Per PREREG.md criteria, the automated verdict is 'inconclusive'.
